Name: The Imitation of Christ
Summary: Thomas a Kempis's devotional manual on following Jesus in humility, prayer, and inward devotion. For six centuries it has been, after the Bible, among the most widely read Christian books.
Contribution: Taught generations that following Christ is inward before it is outward - humility, prayer, and hidden obedience.
Testimony: Its author's testimony is its message: the quiet life of devotion matters more than reputation.
